report:
The study reveals  no definite fracture line .  
 No bone contusion is noted.  
  
  There is loss of signal of entire of the ACL.  PCL is intact . Anterior tibial translation is noted.   
  
  MCL is preserved.    Normal shape with preserved signal of medial meniscus is observed. 
   
   FCL, popliteus tendon, biceps femoris tendon are preserved.  
    Lateral meniscus is not torn. 
  
  Chondrosis along the medial and lateral femoral condyle. 
  No cartilagenous defect is detected.

    Minimal joint effusion is seen. 
    Quadriceps and patellar tendons are preserved.    Complete tear of the ACL

CONSTATATIONS :

Aucune.

Alignement articulaire :
Normal.

Arthrose tricompartimentale légère à modérée, plus prononcée dans les compartiments fémoropatellaire et médial, avec des zones d'amincissement sévère du cartilage au niveau de l'apex rotulien et de la facette médiale, ainsi que dans le compartiment médial portant. Petit foyer d'œdème osseux sous-chondral dans le condyle fémoral médial.

Signal de la moelle osseuse :
Par ailleurs normal.

Ligament croisé antérieur : Normal.
Ligament croisé postérieur : Normal.

Complexe du ligament collatéral latéral : normal.

Tendons extenseurs : Normaux.
Rétinacula patellaire : Normales.

Aucune.

Arthrose tricompartimentale légère à modérée, plus grave dans les compartiments fémoropatellaire et médial.
Changement dégénératif du signal des ménisques sans signe de déchirure significative.
Petit épanchement articulaire.

FINDINGS:  Fluid: Redemonstration of a moderate to severe joint lipohemarthrosis. Uncomplicated popliteal cyst measuring 1.1 x 1.5 cm.  Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage): Normal.  Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage): Normal.  Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments): Normal.  Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad): There is redemonstration of a small detached linear ossific fragment adjacent to the medial patellar facet which appears related to donor site on the medial aspect of the patella which has associated focal bone marrow contusion. As identified on the previous CT scan. In addition adjacent to this there are several rounded or ovoid areas within the joint effusion/hemarthrosis with reduced signal characteristics on the fat-sat sequences and intermediate to high signal intensity on the nonfat sat PD images which likely represents some residual fat related to the previously identified lipohemarthrosis.  In addition, there is corresponding extensive focal subcortical bone contusion involving the lateral aspect of the lateral femoral condyle.  There is some thickening and increased signal intensity involving the medial patellar retinaculum suspicious for sprain or low-grade partial tear.  Muscles and neurovascular structures: Normal.  Other findings: None  CONCLUSION: 1.Sequela of lateral patellar dislocation are redemonstrated consistent with that seen on the previous CT scan. 2.Linear displaced fragment from the medial inferior patella with associated donor site and bone marrow contusion involving the patella. 3.Extensive focal subcortical bone contusion involving the lateral aspect of the lateral femoral condyle. 4.Suspected sprain or low-grade partial tear involving the medial patellar retinaculum at its patellar attachment. 5.Moderate lipohemarthrosis with multiple globules of fat identified within the fluid within the knee joint [see key images].

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Medial RIGHT knee pain for the past 2 months
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Mild amount of reactive marrow edema at the medial femoral condyle. Marginal osteophytes are noted at the distal femur, proximal tibia, and patella. No acute fracture. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Diffuse chondral thinning along the anterior weightbearing and focal full thickness chondral loss at the margin of medial femoral condyle. The tibial plateau cartilage is normal.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal. Small intraosseous ganglion at the tibial attachment of the posterior cruciate ligament.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Mild thickening of the medial collateral ligament with trace periligamentous edema consistent with degenerative MCL signal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 10 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Osteoarthritis with full thickness chondral loss involving the medial femoral condyle and subchondral reactive edema.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Knee pain, injury 2 years prior.
Comparison: [REDACTED].

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.  

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES: 
Alignment is anatomic.  No acute fracture. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process.  No aggressive osseous lesions.  

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion with mild synovial proliferation. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst. 

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Extensive complex tear of the body, posterior horn and root. Maceration and extrusion of the body. Mild reactive edema adjacent tibial plateau along the medial joint line. 
Medial compartment cartilage: Progression of diffuse high grade cartilage loss with areas of full-thickness cartilage loss along the weight-bearing femoral condyle and tibial plateau.  

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal. 
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defect.  

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT: 
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Redemonstration of cartilage loss and full-thickness fissuring of the patella. Some increased cartilage loss of the trochlea. 

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.  
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.  

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Periligamentous edema which may represent low grade sprain or reactivate edema from medial meniscus tear.  
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.  
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal. 

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild quadriceps insertion tendinosis. No tendon tear.
Patella tendon: Mild patellar tendinosis. No tendon tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.  
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad.  No lateral patellar tilt or translation.  No patella alta.  Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 14 mm. 

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy.  Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact. 

SOFT TISSUES:
Nonspecific prepatellar soft tissue edema. No soft tissue mass. 
Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle. 

IMPRESSION: 
1.	[REDACTED]. 
2.	Medial and patellofemoral compartmental chondrosis, progressed from prior. 
3.	Periligamentous edema about the medial collateral ligament which may represent low grade sprain or reactivate edema from medial meniscus tear.
4.	Small left knee effusion with synovial proliferation.

CONSTATATIONS :

Fractures :
Aucune.

Alignement articulaire :
Normal.

Changements dégénératifs :
Arthrose médiale légère à modérée, arthrose fémoropatellaire modérée et arthrose latérale légère avec chondropatie proportionnelle globale. Des foyers de chondropatie sévère ont été notés au niveau de l'apex patellaire et de la facette médiale, ainsi qu'au niveau du condyle fémoral médial portant, avec un œdème réactionnel de la moelle osseuse associé.

Signal de la moelle osseuse : Par ailleurs normal.

Ligament croisé antérieur : Normal.
Ligament croisé postérieur : Normal.
Ligament collatéral médial : Normal.
Complexe du ligament collatéral latéral : normal.

Ménisque médial : Normal.
Ménisque latéral : Normal.

Tendons extenseurs : Normal.
Rétinacula patellaire : Normal.
Pes anserinus : Normal.

Coin postéro-médial et postéro-latéral : Normal.

Épanchement articulaire : Minuscule épanchement articulaire non significatif.
Kyste de Baker : Aucun.

Autres trouvailles significatives :
Petit kyste ganglionnaire non significatif à la jonction myotendineuse du muscle poplité.

CONCLUSION :
Arthrose tricompartimentale légère à modérée, plus importante dans les compartiments médial et fémoropatellaire, telle que décrite.
Pas de déchirure méniscale ou ligamentaire.

Trouvailles:

Il y a un signal normal de la moelle osseuse. Il n'y a pas de fracture ou de contusion. Il y a un léger amincissement du cartilage impliquant les trois compartiments sans région de perte de cartilage complet.

Il y a des changements dégénératifs intrasubstances impliquant le corps et la corne postérieure du ménisque interne. Il y a une déchirure longitudinale d'orientation horizontale s'étendant de la corne postérieure, jusqu'au niveau du corps du ménisque interne. La déchirure s'étend à la surface articulaire inférieure du ménisque. Il y a un petit kyste paraméniscal millimétrique adjacent à la corne postérieure et au corps. Il n'y a pas de fragment déplacé. Le ménisque externe est sans particularité.

Autrement, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et le tendon du poplité, le biceps femoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibiale sont sans particularité.

Conclusion:

1- Rotule sans particularité sans fracture ou contusion. Légers changements dégénératifs des trois compartiments.

2- Changements dégénératifs intrasubstances du ménisque interne avec une déchirure horizontale telle que détaillée ci-haut.

3- Aucune évidence de blessure ligamentaire.

МР находка: Наличие на ставен излив. Костите, формиращи колянната става са с нормална форма. Артикулиращия хрущял на фемура и тибията е запазен. Вижда се малка зона на костномозъчен едем в медиалния кондил на фемура. МР данни за увреда и на медиалния менискус тип „bucket-handle”. Вижда се, че част от менискуса не е на топичното си място, а се проектира под задната кръстна връзка – т.нар „double PCL sign”. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Кръстните връзки са със запазена цялост. Нормално изобразяване на колатералните лигаменти. Пателата е лекостепенно дислоцирана в латерално направление. Хрущял на пателата, ретинакулуми – б.о. Лигамент на пателата и сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис – без особености. Оток на меките тъкани около колянната става.  Заключение: МР данни за увреда на медиалния менискус тип „bucket-handle”. Малък травматичен костномозъчен едем в медиалния кондил на тибията. Ставен излив. Лекостепенна дислокация на пателата.

МР находка: Наличие на малък ставен излив. Костите, формиращи дясната колянна става са с нормална структура. Вижда се ограничена зона на контузионен костномозъчен едем дорзално в епифизата на медиалното тибиално плато. Сред мастната подложка на Hoffa, зад лигамента на пателата се изобразява овална структура с р-р 10/3,5мм. Находката е с костна структура и съответства на вътреставно свободно тяло. Втора лезия със сходна макроморфология се изобразява и пред медиалния кондил на фемура. Визуализира се остеохондрален дефект по предната повърхност на медиалния кондил на фемура. Дефектът в хрущяла съответства по форма на описаното свободно тяло пред медиалния кондил на фемура. Наличие на начални, минимални остеофити по ставните повърхности на медиалните кондили на фемура и тибията. Кръстните връзки са със запазена цялост. МР данни за руптура на задния рог на медиалния менискус. Свързани с менискуса се изобразяват множество перименискални малки кисти. Дегенеративно променен латерален менискус. Наличие на малък ставен излив. Колатералните лигаменти са със запазена цялост. Наличие на остеофити по горната и долната повърхност на пателата на залавните места на лигамента на пателата и на сухожилието на м. квадрицепс феморис. Хрущял на пателата, ретинакулуми – без особености. Изобразяват се дискретни дефекти в хрущяла по предната повърхност на фемура (ретропателарно). Поплитеална ямка – без особености. Заключение: МР данни за малък ставен излив. Остеохондрален дефект във фемура с описаната локализация. Свободни вътреставни тела. Лезия на заден рог на медиалния менискус – 3 степен.
